Energies are reduced stationary work-functionals on an open port with a weakly leaking continued mode. Output is quasistatic displacement along a trial direction and not a time series. Total includes carrier and order energies on both sides. Two histories distinguish a repeatedly stress-free central core from one with a frozen reference, initially stress-free and perfectly bonded at the cut. Positive-radius meridians cannot undergo pore closure.

import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from numpy.polynomial.legendre import leggauss,legval
sys.path.insert(0,"software/stage1_solver/tools")
from mouth_strained_wave import cell_tangents
from mouth_live_waist_wave import OccupiedWave
from mouth_exchange_shear import DEGREE
from mouth_sealed_shape_relax import Meridian
from mouth_shallow_puncture_fields import read_case,PORT
from scipy import sparse
def pocket(wave,shape,c,v,wt):
    mesh=wave.mesh; nt=len(wave.ids)//mesh
    i,j=np.indices((mesh,nt)).reshape(2,-1)
    node=np.r_[v,0j][wave.ids]
    dz=shape.length/nt
    radial=axial=mass=0j
    q,w=leggauss(3)
    for z,wz in zip((1+q)/2,w/2):
        t=(j+z)/nt;b,db,_=shape.profile(t)
        edge=np.exp(-np.exp(legval(2*t-1,c))/2)
        left=i/mesh;span=np.clip(edge-left,0,1/mesh)
        for y,wy in zip((1+q)/2,w/2):
            x=left+span*y; u=mesh*span*y; r=x*b
            bot=(1-u)*node[:,0]+u*node[:,1]
            top=(1-u)*node[:,2]+u*node[:,3]
            f=(1-z)*bot+z*top
            fr=mesh*((1-z)*(node[:,1]-node[:,0])+z*(node[:,3]-node[:,2]))/b
            fw=(top-bot)/dz-x*db*fr
            measure=wt*wz*wy*r*r*b*span*dz
            radial+=measure@(r*r*fr*fr+(DEGREE*(DEGREE+1)-2)*f*f)
            axial+=measure@(r*r*fw*fw)
            mass+=measure@(r*r*f*f)
    return radial,axial,mass
def pencil(R,pars,c,chi,mesh):
    shape=Meridian(R,pars)
    wave=OccupiedWave(shape,72,144,mesh,PORT)
    feed=sparse.diags((wave.uniform[0][:,1]<=0).astype(float))
    weight=wave.project@chi.T.ravel()
    k,m=cell_tangents(wave,shape,c,3)
    return wave,feed@wave.cut_k@feed+wave.matrix(weight[:,None,None]*k),feed@wave.cut_m@feed+wave.matrix(weight[:,None,None]*m)
for R in (1,2):
    prep,*_=read_case(R,72)

    base,k,m=pencil(R,x,c,chi,prep["field_mesh"])
    edge=v[base.port.ids]
    db=(base.port.block(om+2e-6)-base.port.block(om-2e-6))/(4e-6)
    den=2*om*(v@(m@v))+edge@(db@edge)
    A,B,Mc=pocket(base,Meridian(R,x),c,v,base.project@chi.T.ravel())
    h=.0007;d=np.array([h,0,0,0])

    core=(A-B-om**2*Mc)/den
    print(json.dumps(dict(radius=R,mesh=72,refitted_wave=True,entire_refreshed_log_depth_derivative=entire.real,from_core_only=core.real,carried_core_residual=abs(entire-core))),flush=True)

Only that incomplete control was repeated, with the projected gradient independently recomputed and a feasible-point energy test for roundoff. Both successful completions at R1 and the fine R2 control were preserved. The frozen-core trials are separate physical perturbations.

review.refreshed_joint_scope: Scoped clear for the additive static, two-sided order/carrier and strained-wave energy on the specified split reference and for a resolved energy-lowering direction at a held shallow starting profile. A negative single-site reopening derivative is local reordering of the prepared field. Neither this variation nor the finite family of positive-radius profiles establishes aperture closure, a minimum radius, or free shape equilibrium.
review.bonded_and_final: Scoped clear for the neutral compression and rank-one stiffness tests, the axial wave-work distinction between reformed and permanently bonded cores, and numerical balance in the three released coordinates at both training radii. The independent exit variation lowers the energy toward a smaller exit on both meshes. Free equilibrium, healing, a limiting radius and 0PN inertia remain unresolved.
